name: humanizer
title: Humanizer
description: Rewrites AI-sounding text so it reads like its human writer, without changing what it says: removes not-X-but-Y contrasts, staged openers, forced triads, inflated claims, stock AI words and filler.
why: Nothing else in the collection does dedicated AI-tell removal — copy-editing sharpens marketing copy; this de-robots any prose. Directly useful for public-facing text and channel content, where a human voice is the brand.
